status: Conditional connected ordinary north-eave bay and endpoint; no selected fabrication, material, roof, fire, thermal or physical admission.

plan.qualification: The q450 row is a MAT/STR coordinated development delta, not the old STR JSON purlin row at8300. The endpoint post/frame/purlin convergence is an unresolved three-dimensional welded/bolted geometry, not a free bay collar.

bay.roofAVCL: 1 mm supported metal at lower face of320 glass; post has independent welded AVCL collar; no glass bears cover loads.
bay.airReturn: q550 down to z6640, q489.5 at collector finish; below collector underside6540 to ordinary q429.5 finish.
bay.thermal: 500.7 normal roof/320 glass contacts ordinary 429.5 wall/110 glass; collector260 replaces60 locally, leaving50 glass; toe/retainer and wallhead/cavity cap unresolved.

frame.compoundJoint: Separate q450 post collar on field AVCL plus q550 frame-skin saddle; no unpierced q550 drop through steel. Their 100 mm plan separation is not a weld/access clearance proof.
frame.ceiling: Protected top6620/bottom6444 stops at collector finish489.5; independent support and complete classified96 return to soffit6540 remain required.

paths.air: Room plaster → clamped finish transition → bay q550 return → supported roof AVCL. At discrete frame axes the separate upper/lower sheet edges must connect by an all-around qualified saddle to closed, sealed SHS skin; post collars are separate and remain finite at the q450 grid.
paths.coldWater: Moving zinc hem discharges into receiver; separate breather laps over cold-side support to its own drip, also entering the same receiver. A blocked receiver is common failure, not redundancy.
paths.ventilation: 30 gross eave throat, minimum50 percent mesh yields15 equivalent; each of six 490.833×50 channels runs inward beside NS rails. No EW blocking. High exit/ridge/hip/valley/corners unqualified.
paths.fire: The protected ceiling176 with100 wool and classified96 perimeter terminates at projecting collector face; never trim the family or run through RC.

jointSchedule.operation: Set collector cage/seat and primary frame with access to its full skin; verify actual load path and linked shear.
jointSchedule.hold: STR collector and frame ends/joints, closed skin, corrosion and weld-access proof; no frame as generic air seal.

jointSchedule.operation: Set end purlin q450 and lower boards; fit post bases at all seven x, including two compound frame axes; reserve collar access before glass.
jointSchedule.hold: STR owning row/source and local 3D purlin/frame/post weld, bolt, load, erection and 10 allowance.

jointSchedule.operation: Join supported AVCL across lower board field; collar each post at q439.435; in bays fold q550 return; at frame axes weld distinct upper/lower saddle edges to closed SHS skin.
jointSchedule.hold: Full all-around access, sealed frame ends, tested sheet/steel/plaster joint, differential movement, corrosion, serviceability and vapour performance.

jointSchedule.operation: Fit320 bare glass and wall110 with actual50 neck around collector, toe support and movement-compatible retention; hold wall cavity head and fire closure.
jointSchedule.hold: 3D post/frame/collector heat and transient hygrothermal/drying, full constituents and mechanical retention.

jointSchedule.operation: Complete protected176 ceiling on independent supports to collector finish; provide complete classified96 return at soffit6540.
jointSchedule.hold: IAS/STR classified assembly and real end support; 12 mm z6640–6628 reservation is only a geometry screen.

jointSchedule.operation: Install breather with separate collars at posts, cold NS rails, open EW boards, moving zinc hem, vent mesh and secondary drip.
jointSchedule.hold: ROF system/fasteners, movement, high vent exit and water lap testing; no EW vent blockage.

jointSchedule.operation: Use exterior access for inspection; renew gutter from its cold rail cradles, protect exposed roof temporarily for deeper sheet/glass repair.
jointSchedule.hold: RWT common receiver blockage, catchment/capacity and maintainable weather state; roof is not a walking surface.

thermalFalsifier.interpretation: At authored20/0C and films0.13/0.04, collector underside is sensitive. These cut-specific figures do not include finite post collars, hollow steel or installed vapour/air leakage; no surface, condensation, whole-U or ISO psi acceptance. A worse joined 3D/climate result or failed movement-compatible closure defeats this assembly.

verdict: The bay and edge paths can be drawn together, but the two endpoint compound post/frame junctions, actual air weld access, classified perimeter and upper vent exits prevent selection. Six-row owning exit remains open.
